annotations.text:
COLOUR — Layout 1 in three map-aware schemes.
On a map screen the brand colour cannot be a background: the map owns 55% of the pixels. So primary lives only in pins, the FAB and suggestions; each space gets its own accent from a fixed six-hue set.
Type is held constant (Bricolage Grotesque + Manrope) so you are judging colour only — the pairing is still open.

MANY SPACES — the chip row is a shortcut, not the control.
Three frames answer it: a switcher sheet that scales to any number, several spaces on the map at once with colour-coded clusters, and single-space focus that absorbs the old Space Detail screen.
